meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会给这台机器接一个 Dial 真实电话号码,能收发短信、用 AI 接听语音来电。它会复制 Dial 适配器和测试、装依赖并构建、登录 Dial 账号、登记号码、重启服务,最后用 6 位配对码把你的手机绑为机主。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 接一个能收发短信、接听 AI 语音电话的真实号码时启用;安装过程中会调起 pair-dial 配对步骤,并在重启后注册号码。

say.text: 给 Claude 加一个 Dial 电话号码吧
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖、构建并登录 Dial

say.text: 把来电问候语改成:你好,请问找哪位?
say.note: 写入该号码的 inbound instruction

say.text: 这个号码只允许我自己发短信

howto.what_en: After install, Claude wires a real Dial phone number into this machine for SMS and AI voice calls. It copies the Dial adapter and tests, installs deps, builds, signs in to Dial, registers the line, restarts the service, then pairs your phone.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want Claude to have a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls; it also runs the pair-dial step during setup and registers the line after restart.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number to Claude
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds, signs in

say_en.text: Change the inbound greeting on my Dial line
